description: This file defines a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent. It includes functions for resolving collection candidates, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different schema types, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. The main exported function, getLlmCostByAgent, attempts database-level aggregation and falls back to in-memory processing if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines candidate collection names from environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs'.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with flat schema for agent costs, supporting various indexation and cost formats.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Builds a pipeline for documents where agents and costs are in an 'Agents' array with 'Agent Name' and 'Total Cost'.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation over an array of documents with 'Agents' array, summing costs by agent name with case-insensitive grouping and preserving display casing.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to retrieve and aggregate LLM costs from the database using optimized pipelines, with fallback to in-process aggregation if needed.
